budget_items.topic: Water Commission study and Hickory Hills Lake well
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Water Commission chair announced a special meeting on a vote to spend $360,000 to study water treatment and reopen the Hickory Hills Lake well.
budget_items.quote: voting to spend $360,000 to study water treatment and reopening of the hickory hills lake well

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Jeffreys said Town Meeting debating individual capital items would mean debating a range of spending from $750,000 to $2.8 million.
budget_items.quote: one way to disinterest a huge group of people is by discussing for hours how we're going to spend

budget_items.topic: Capital Plan funding and project count
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager said the Town has added funds to the Capital Plan annually, and the project count has risen (fifteen projects in FY22, 23 the year before).
budget_items.quote: we have spent additional funds annually on the capital plan due to available funding, so the number of projects has increased

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Departments were sent the information to submit capital requests for fiscal years 2024 to 2033, due October 13.
budget_items.quote: submissions are due back on october 13th.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Discussion of debt capacity: school projects use most of it and the Middle/High School debt runs to 2045.
budget_items.quote: mr. jeffreys noted the majority of our debt capacity are school renovations or new schools and after that there isn't much left.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Dwyer said projects start with a budget number that comes out higher after design.
budget_items.quote: when these projects are undertaken we have a budget number already and it goes through the design process

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Municipal Building Design Committee reviewed three scenarios including their monetary implications.
budget_items.quote: and the pros and cons of each, the monetary implications etc.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town closed on the purchase of the streetlights from Unitil and is now the owner of the fixtures. No price was recorded.
budget_items.quote: the closing for the purchase of the streetlights from unitil was last thursday and the town is now the

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager described the legislature revisiting the Economic Development Bill and tax relief returning more than $2.9 billion to taxpayers.
budget_items.quote: which will return more than $2.9 billion back to taxpayers via checks and direct deposits.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Historical Society's raffle ticket sale for the Whalom Park bench was to offset some of their expenses. No amount was given.
budget_items.quote: this will help offset some of their expenses.
